caption:
Ingredients:
* 1 can of tomatoes (crushed or whole, your choice!)
* 1 tbsp olive oil
* 2-3 garlic cloves, minced
* 1 onion, finely chopped (optional but so worth it!)
* 1-2 tbsp oregano + chili flakes (trust your taste!)
* Salt & pepper (to your liking)
* Pinch of sugar (to balance out the tomato acidity)
* 4 soft pav 
* 1 packet of chicken meatballs from @trystgourmet (because who has time to make them from scratch?)
* 1/2 cup grated cheese (or as much as your heart desires 🧀)

Method:  Heat that olive oil in a pan over medium heat. 🍳 Sauté the garlic + onion for 2-3 minutes until your kitchen smells AMAZING. 🙌
Add the can of tomatoes, breaking them down with a spoon (if they’re whole).
Season it up with oregano, chili flakes, salt, pepper, and a little sugar to balance the flavor. Stir it all together and let it simmer for 10-15 minutes. 🍅💥
Toast your pav until golden and crispy, and cook up those juicy chicken meatballs. 👩‍🍳
Assemble: Layer your pav with the marinara sauce, meatballs, and plenty of melted cheese. 🧀🔥

And boom! You’ve got a mouth-watering meatball sub in no time. Perfect for lazy days, busy nights, or just satisfying those cravings! 💥
Don’t forget to save this recipe for later – you’ll want it on repeat! 😋🍴#dinner #girldinner
